primary.qualification: Finite authored catalogue fixed before full execution; not a population estimate. This is a storage-format and encoding-aware selection experiment using established lossless codecs and optimization methods. No new general compression algorithm or universal dominance is claimed. Recovery times are single descriptive measurements, not a timing comparison.

scientific.qualification: Byte-level transfer of every older frozen condition, not fresh model replay. Missing candidates and selected-only large Letter measurements remain explicit. Equal-codec manual optima must tie. Encoded bytes, all metadata and one-byte mode prefixes count. Unknown cases are nonwins in full-denominator saving rates.
